games.description: A brief solo introduction to the Tucker farm is interrupted for a multiplayer game. The full return follows Henry through fixed-camera exploration, limited inventory, hiding and household puzzles to an escape ending.
games.title: Cannibal Abduction

games.description: A completed solo psychological-horror shift at a helpline. Sark takes increasingly strange calls, searches the office for instructions, navigates its lettered halls and colored access cards, and survives the final chase to the to-be-continued ending.
games.title: experiment: one

games.description: A long solo journey through Nerea’s nightmare. Sark searches the city and sewers, survives the haunted houses and forest maze, reaches the party, and battles the timed driving finale across repeated attempts. The successful run was recorded during a Discord stream and later replayed on this Twitch stream, with the ending and his reactions preserved.
